artifacts.summary: 10-phase plan consolidating the state-space topology into a citable collection: Gap A/B promotions, four frame-level declarations, citation-granularity ledger rows, and the appendix support table.

memory_candidates.content: In a Lean library gated by a per-theorem ledger plus a dead-declaration census, promoting terminal counterexample declarations (results nothing else in the library references) and adding their ledger rows must be planned as one arc, not as separate rounds. The census's occurrence corpus includes non-spec markdown, so the ledger row is itself the occurrence that keeps the promoted declaration off the dead-declaration report. Planning them apart produces a round that is green but flagged, followed by a second round that only un-flags it.
